subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "that"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Clause* that* has been used which conveys what the subject is doing without any random act. 
 
• The given passage delivers the message about the cunningness held behind the crocodile's intention.
 
• With the intention of dinner he called him and even carried him on his back.
 
• He was so happy that he wanted to trick the Monkey into a complex situation.

 
• The final answer is **"The crocodile was happy that __he had tricked the monkey, however, while talking."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• **While** is a conjunction used to join two sentences of place, time and direction. 

 
 
• **Example: **She went to the zoo while he went to Shimla.
 
 
 
• **Whether** is used to answer yes or no type questions.
 
 
• **Example: **He asked me whether I am happy or not.
 
 
 
• **Before:** Can be used as a conjunction, adverb and preposition.
 
 
• **Example:** Think carefully before you speak. **(Conjunction).**
 
• **Example:** She woke up before he could leave. **(Preposition).**
 
• **Example: **I only met him once before.** (adverb)**
